cases.customer_question: How should we proceed with Bluetooth SIG qualification when using either a Component (v5.3) or a Core-Controller (v6.1) design that appear to overlap?
cases.actual_issue: Overlapping RF PHY, LL, and HCI layers between different design approaches creates ambiguity in how to structure qualification and reuse evidence.
cases.consultant_answer: The Component and Core-Controller designs both cover the same lower layers (RF PHY, LL, HCI), so they cannot be independently reused without considering overlap. Instead, a new qualification must be created that includes RF PHY test reports (1M, 2M, Coded) and PTS-based profile test reports (DIS) as evidence. The final design submission should consolidate the required layers and include both RF and profile validation evidence.
cases.final_recommendation: Create a new qualification listing that includes RF PHY test reports and DIS PTS test evidence, regardless of whether starting from Component or Core-Controller, and submit as a new design including all required layers.
